title: Checkout clock and fixture guide
text: Production checkout takes now from the server clock. Local fixture API accepts now explicitly for deterministic tests. POST /test-support/promotions {expiresAt} returns {code}. POST /checkout/quote {code,subtotal,now} returns {total} or {error}. Test support must never be enabled in production.

title: Inventory reservation contention / docs
text: Reservation design: lock SKU row, check available quantity, insert reservation and decrement in one transaction. Release reservation on timeout. Idempotency records expire after 24 hours.

title: Tenant cache isolation / docs
text: Identity profile cache key contract: tenantId + userId + schemaVersion. Token middleware validates tenant claim before lookup. Cache values are immutable DTOs; TTL 60s.
